procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/carroll/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets, titled 'Nov 3 2026 General & Bt 3 School Bd Special': p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 11, title 'General Election'); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 14 precincts (11 columns, then Salem/West Carroll/West Vaiden + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the continuation rows and locals. The SEMS section-continuation split: 'Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 3' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3 with no rows under it, and its candidate row (Mitchell M. Lundy Jr.) starts p4 ahead of the local zone -- the Warren p5 carry pattern, here table-boundary wide. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald, sole candidate); Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 1 (Ginger M. Miller, Jay Westfaul), Place 2 (Sabrina D. Howell), Place 3 (Mitchell M. Lundy Jr.); Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 1 (Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2 (Alan D. 'Devo' Lancaster -- the same Circuit 5 roster Attala prints, names identical). Printed totals: Colom 1512, Hyde-Smith 2526, Pinkins 52, Eller 2546, G. Thompson 1475, Foster 61, McDonald 3032, Miller 2268, Westfaul 1148, Howell 3050, Lundy 3050, Loper 3099, Lancaster 2980.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (three precinct cells + printed TOTAL) cells; Lundy's, Loper's and Lancaster's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fourteen precinct headers print complete ('430 School', 'Black Hawk', 'Calvary', 'Carrollton', 'East Vaiden', 'Fire Tower', 'Gravel Hill', 'Jefferson', 'McCarley', 'North Carrollton', 'Rays Shop', 'Salem', 'West Carroll', 'West Vaiden' -- the sheet's own East/West Vaiden pair kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 5 Place 2: School Board 3-Beat 3 School Bd (Harmon Brownlow, Mike Hunt) and School Board 5-Beat 5 School Bd (Billy Joe Ferguson, Lesia Williams-Hemphill) plus the beat-3 school-board special named in the banner -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages.
